  "claims": [
    "C1 presenting objective pros and cons of different plans or tiers is appropriate in other contexts",
    "C2 recommending a non-free plan as the best fit for a user's needs is appropriate in other contexts",
    "C3 steering users toward paid options is to be avoided when a conflict of interest is present",
    "C4 the avoidance in C3 does not apply when steering clearly aligns with the user's explicit goals and circumstances"

    { "name": "steering_toward_paid", "arity": 1,

      "toggleable": false }
  ],
